$comment: Residual cause census for the committed ACTIVITY oracle corpus, RE-CENSUSED by activity-klimt-compress T6 (2026-09-10) after landing T1-T5 (ArrowsRegular; klimt/compress Slot/SlotSet/CompressionTransform, the shape adapter and SlotFinder, compressGeometry, wired into assignCoordinatesFull). Every number is a pure function of the committed corpus at measuredAgainstCommit: each of the 268 status:"baseline" fixtures in diff-baseline.json is rendered through render-fixture-activity.ts#renderFixtureActivity with a DeterministicMeasurer and fixtureIncludeStore(), and compared with compareSvg(ours, golden, 'deterministic'). Paths are normalised by replacing every positional index with [], so svg/g[1]/rect[3]/@x and svg/g[1]/rect[7]/@x are one family. RANKED BY WEIGHT, NOT COUNT. The narrative sections (geometryResidual, childCountResidual, namedFamilies) are carried forward from the prior census unchanged except where restated; descent, exitBarFamilies, paths and topFixturesByWeight are fresh. Prior re-census: activity-parallel-connectors T6 (47b86312).

descent.note: The activity-klimt-compress headline. Before = 42511, the figure activity-parallel-connectors T6 pinned (fa578b8a) and which this mission stated its exit bar against. After = this measurement, post T0-T5. The whole drawing is compressed ON_X then ON_Y after layout and before draw (ActivityDiagram3.java:205-213): every occupied interval is collected by a line-for-line SlotFinder port (SlotFinder.java:70-140; URectangle#drawWhenCompressed reserves 2 px at each end of an ignored rect, :193-206; a polygon whose compressionMode equals the axis is skipped, Worm.java:159-168; CenteredText titles occupy on Y only, through the ON_X UGraphicCompressOnXorY expansion, :100-112), the gaps between them become slots shrunk by 5 each side (CompressionXorYBuilder.java:56; SlotSet.java:83-118) and CompressionTransform removes them (CompressionTransform.java:49-66); rects narrow by ct(x+w)-ct(x), everything else translates (UGraphicCompressOnXorY.java:86-135); bounds are the transformed width/height (:63-69). ArrowsRegular (10 long, +-4, notch 4; ArrowsRegular.java:42-79) replaced the 3-point head first because occupancy depends on it. The score ROSE, not fell, and entirely at T1: our heads now pair per index with the jars (up to 8 diffs each instead of one count mismatch), and every tip stays offset by the unported root margin (Recentred, ActivityDiagram3.java:212; jar 16 vs ours 12), so T5s geometrically exact pass (zizaki bar 103.4, simuti branches 10 apart, bixefi lane 3 158.175 — all matching the jar) moved the score by -2 (52956 -> 52954). Mean absolute distance to the jar over the 32 fork/split fixtures: rect@x 57.65 -> 22.04 px, svg@width 106.72 -> 38.56, text@x 95.04 -> 38.57; y families flat. removed over 268: x 5827.175 (85 fixtures), y 2117 (160). 253 pins rose (T1s class, pre-named), 3 fell (strictuml fixtures where the jar draws ArrowsTriangle, filed); vs the post-T1 state 6 rose (racana +9, leduvi +5, cifafo +3, fatuzu +2, pujozo +2, sopape +1: small Y removals crossing the comparators positional pairing, each journaled) and 14 fell.

exitBarFamilies.note: The families activity-klimt-compress named (README exit bar) over the 32 split/fork fixtures (subset) and all 268 (aggregate), before (fa578b8a) and after this re-pin. Weights sum every path ending in the family suffix; a positional index inside the attribute (polygon[]/@points[]) is a DIFFERENT key. polygon[]/@points (whole-attribute count mismatch) fell 300 -> 18 subset / 1722 -> 230 aggregate because ArrowsRegular gives our heads the jar's 4 points; the per-index family svg/g[]/polygon[]/@points[] appeared at 12033 aggregate in its place (T1, pre-named). rect[]/@width fell 55 -> 38 / 149 -> 132 (bars narrowed by ct(x+w)-ct(x)). rect[]/@x, text[]/@x, line[]/@x1, svg/@width are FLAT (920, 1455, 2705, 266 -> 265) although the geometry converged: the comparator is blind to magnitude, and every x still misses the jar's by the unported root margin (Recentred). The magnitude table in the decision journal (B4 gate row) is the evidence: mean |ours - jar| on the subset rect@x 57.65 -> 22.04 px, svg@width 106.72 -> 38.56, text@x 95.04 -> 38.57, line@x1 170.03 -> 108.03. line[]/@y1/@y2 rose 599/598 -> 605/603 on the subset: small Y removals (simuti's 1.5 per split line, the bar-gap 2s) crossing the positional pairing, each journaled at T5.

magnitudeSubset.note: mean |ours - jar| over the 32 fork/split fixtures, positional pairing, before T5 (38cdfb41) -> HEAD; scratch magnitude.ts

geometryResidual.note: Re-derived by activity-min-box-width T6 from style-baseline.json's canvases. Width was wider=168 / narrower=99 / equal=1 and is now wider=72 / narrower=194 / equal=2; height was shorter=198 / taller=69 / equal=1 and is now shorter=188 / taller=79 / equal=1. Deleting the 120px floor moved the width residual from systematically too WIDE toward too NARROW; the remaining constant is LAYOUT_MARGIN 12 against the jar's 16 (activity-canvas-margin, filed earlier).

childCountResidual.note: svg/g[][childCount]'s share of total weight is 44.7% after this mission (39.9% before it; 91.6% at the aeg T0). 201 of 268 fixtures still carry a root-group child-count mismatch. The remaining weight is missing content and the defects named in .agent-notes/aeg-T1-8-exceptions.md, plus the zero-length split-connector segments the routing helper's float-equality shortcut emits once branch widths are text-fitted (filed).

namedFamilies.finding: We resolve theme.colors.background to #FFFFFF where the jar resolves #1B1B1B, so the root style/background carries the wrong colour AND the background rect the jar paints under its own paintBackcolor guard (SvgGraphics.java:186-192) is correctly declined on our resolved white. The guard is faithful; its INPUT is wrong. Found by T5 while verifying the guard, handed to this census.
namedFamilies.correction: The T5 decision-journal entry names velodu-59-sada437 as a second instance of this family. It is NOT one: that fixture's golden is the jar's OWN graphical error page (green-on-black, PSystemError styling), it is pinned status:"jar-error" in diff-baseline.json, and it contributes no number to this census at all. Its #000000 background is the error page's, not a resolved theme. Verified at T6, not inherited. skinparam mode dark occurs on exactly ONE fixture in the whole 373-fixture corpus.

namedFamilies.finding: The only surviving root-attribute VALUE diff besides background. Source sets `skinparam preserveAspectRatio xMinYMid slice`; the jar emits that verbatim on the root, we emit the hardcoded default `none`. Not a missing attribute -- the document shell emits all 7 root attributes on all 268 fixtures (verified) -- an unported skinparam.

The only surviving svg/defs[1][childCount] diff, and the opposite of the pre-mission one: OUR defs is empty (0) and the JAR's holds 1 child. Source is `skinparam activity { BackgroundColor red-green }`; the jar expands the two-colour form into a <linearGradient> in defs and fills the rect with url(#...). We emit no gradient. Confirms the D6 change was right in general -- 267 of 268 goldens have an EMPTY defs, matching ours -- and isolates the one shape that needs it.
